verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent tracing and observability product, so masking sensitive data before it is stored in traces is a fair question for it. The evidence covers span capture, tagging, and init() kwargs (user_id, session_id, tags), but nothing on redaction, masking, PII scrubbing, or pre-storage filtering hooks. Routing traces through a user's own OpenTelemetry pipeline would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
